MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is correct spelling with tones important? (1 mark)
   A. A wrong tone can change the meaning
   B. Tones do not matter
   C. Only characters matter
   D. Only capital letters matter

2. Which sentence means "The chair is under the table."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在客厅。
   B. 沙发在门旁边。
   C. 卧室里有床。
   D. 椅子在桌子下。

3. What does 八 (bā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Nine
   C. Ten
   D. Eight

4. What does 今天 (jīntiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow
   B. Mosque
   C. School
   D. Today

5. Which order does a sentence about the week use? (1 mark)
   A. what + when + who
   B. what + who + when
   C. when + what + who
   D. who + when + what

6. What does 星期天 (xīngqītiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Seven
   C. Sunday
   D. Today

7. What does 五 (wǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Five
   C. Nine
   D. Seven

8. How many strokes does 日 have? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 6

9. What is a 田字格 used for? (1 mark)
   A. Writing characters neatly in a square with cross lines
   B. Counting money
   C. Drawing maps
   D. Cutting paper

10. What does 肉 (ròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Biscuits
   B. Banana
   C. Meat
   D. Grapes

11. What does 吃 (chī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Lunch
   B. To like
   C. To eat
   D. Beef

12. What is the last stroke written in 头? (1 mark)
   A. 撇 piě
   B. 横 héng
   C. 捺 nà
   D. 点 diǎn

13. What does 肩膀 (jiānbǎng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To look, to see
   B. Shoulder
   C. To speak
   D. Tooth

14. Which character means "mouth" and has 3 strokes? (1 mark)
   A. 口
   B. 手
   C. 头
   D. 耳

15. What does 没有 méiyǒu mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is not
   B. Also
   C. Very
   D. Today

16. How many strokes does 雨 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 11
   C. 6
   D. 8

17. Fill the blank: 花园在房子____。 (The garden is on the right of the house.) (1 mark)
   A. 下面
   B. 左边
   C. 里
   D. 右边

18. Which stroke is written first in 右? (1 mark)
   A. 竖 shù
   B. 点 diǎn
   C. 横 héng
   D. 撇 piě

19. What should you check on your display before a showcase? (1 mark)
   A. Only the colour
   B. Tone marks, stroke order, spelling and neat writing
   C. Nothing
   D. Only the size

20. What should you do if you make a mistake while presenting? (1 mark)
   A. Stop and cry
   B. Run away
   C. Stay calm, breathe and say it again
   D. Blame a friend

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Decide whether each statement is 对 or 错 and explain. Text: 今天有太阳,没有雨。 Statement: 今天有雨。 (3 marks)

22. Write the stroke names of 手 in order. (3 marks)

23. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. (2 marks)

24. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Tomorrow is Thursday." (3 marks)

25. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: zhè shì xiāngjiāo. (2 marks)

26. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒmen qiē dàngāo. (2 marks)

27. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "Today it rains." (2 marks)

28. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 饮料, 两 and 刀. (3 marks)

29. Write a plan for a model house: name four rooms or things in Chinese with pinyin and write one sentence about it. (4 marks)

30. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 七 and 云. (2 marks)

31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The rain is heavy." (2 marks)

32. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 花园 and 房子. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A wrong tone can change the meaning
   chuáng and chuāng are different words.

2. D — 椅子在桌子下。
   椅子在桌子下。 (yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.) means "The chair is under the table.".

3. D — Eight
   八 (bā) means eight.

4. D — Today
   今天 (jīntiān) means today.

5. D — who + when + what
   我 + 星期三 + 去学校.

6. C — Sunday
   星期天 (xīngqītiān) means Sunday.

7. B — Five
   五 (wǔ) means five.

8. C — 4
   日 has four strokes.

9. A — Writing characters neatly in a square with cross lines
   It keeps characters even and centred.

10. C — Meat
   肉 (ròu) means meat.

11. C — To eat
   吃 (chī) means to eat.

12. C — 捺 nà
   The order is 点, 点, 横, 撇, 捺.

13. B — Shoulder
   肩膀 (jiānbǎng) means shoulder.

14. A — 口
   口 kǒu.

15. A — There is not
   没有 is the opposite of 有.

16. D — 8
   雨 has eight strokes.

17. D — 右边
   右边 is the right side.

18. D — 撇 piě
   右 begins with the falling stroke.

19. B — Tone marks, stroke order, spelling and neat writing
   Careful checking makes the display clear.

20. C — Stay calm, breathe and say it again
   Everyone makes mistakes.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: 错. The text says there is no rain (没有雨).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 错, 1 mark for finding 没有, 1 mark for the explanation.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: The window is above the sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: 明天是星期四。 míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is a banana.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: We cut the cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: 饮料: yǐnliào, drinks. 两: liǎng, two (before a counting word). 刀: dāo, knife.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 厨房 chúfáng, 客厅 kètīng, 卧室 wòshì, 床 chuáng. Sentence: 床在卧室。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name with pinyin, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 七: qī, seven. 云: yún, cloud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 雨很大。 yǔ hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 花园: huāyuán, garden. 房子: fángzi, house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
